timing.reason: Through the current tool bridge, 1500 persisted but did not transition in a four-second playback wait; 1.5 did. The official Figma Plugin API documentation describes timeout milliseconds, so this is an observed tool-bridge behavior, not a general API units recommendation.

returnRouting.reason: A single conditional with 87 blocks persisted as only first and last blocks. Replaced with one two-block conditional action per caller. Readback preserves all 82. Mobile caller return passed subsequent browser playback.

statusComponent.reason: Set-wide text defaults overrode variant-specific status text. Each State now owns its fixed title and description.

booleanScopeException: Figma rejected empty/specialized BOOLEAN scopes. The two prototype booleans explicitly use ALL_SCOPES and hiddenFromPublishing=true.

selectLabel.note: The bridge normalized the requested single-line truncation into fixed-height TRUNCATE. Instance readback and long filename playback confirmed no second line.
